Ardashir and Nefarith serve a Lady, and Nefarith's mention of Talos-V and her own bargain point to further worlds and schemes. This may suggest the Endmin is far older than a human lifetime and that Talos-II is one of several numbered worlds, but the text does not confirm either.

Si, the Feranmut Proxy, is clearly ancient, keeps a prison in the Scroll and speaks fondly of two absent acquaintances and of a city named Yumen whose beacon fires burned for centuries; in the original Arknights, Yumen is a frontier city of Yan. In that game, Yan's Sui are siblings born from an ancient being. Possibly Si is one of those siblings or their kin, and her two acquaintances are other Sui, but this process never says so.

happened: The process opens quietly: the Endministrator seeks out Arcane, and the two revisit the street at the bottom of the gorge she once called home. Back aboard Dijiang, Perlica, Zhuang Fangyi and the Feranmut Proxy Si confront the Endmin about the mark the Æther left during the battle against Alleikhreos. Perlica explains that Originium disrupts the Æther but the reaction works both ways, and the Endmin's weakened body cannot keep enduring it. Zhuang Fangyi has come in person to vouch for Si, since the Endmin has never before left Dijiang for treatment outside Endfield. Perlica, who trusts Si as the Endmin's friend of many years, insists the Endmin go alone, exactly as Si asked.

Si meets the Endmin in the hills and reveals her home: a hanging scroll as tall as a mountain, a painted world that works on its own, keeps visitors away and lets her watch the Exclusion Zone for Hongshan. At its peak floats a painted Dijiang that Si says will heal the Endmin, but first she brings her guest to the inn at the mountain's foot. Its assistants, Job Rusher, Speed Dasher, Loud Speaker and the ink creature Witty, seem to recognise the Endmin, and Job Rusher lets slip that the Endmin was a regular ten years ago. Si shows the Endmin an old room she kept empty for a decade, books untouched, and, claiming she controls time inside the painting, orders the Endmin to sleep.

Rest is interrupted when Si chases a polite golden-haired man out of the inn. He is Ye Minghe of HAS, sent by several Tianshi because the Endmin's safety matters to the whole Civilization Band, and Si resents his meddling. When Witty runs off with Si's brush among the waregeists, objects that gained a mind from living near Si, the Endmin goes after it, and Job Rusher admits Si delayed the climb because she fears the Endmin is too exhausted. The ascent begins at Xiaohe Manor, a village marred by damage that Si explains is the painted Dijiang visualising the Æther Blightification inside the Endmin's body. Wielding Si's brush, the Endmin fills the empty granary and repairs the waterwheel, yet the villagers still plan to leave.

The real problem is faith. The villagers had come to treat their withered Wishing Tree as a protector, which the Endmin likens to depending on a PAC. When the tree revives, Elder Li remembers that his people found it as a sapling, tended it and built the village around it, and he persuades them to stay. Li turns into a spark of inspiration that lets the Endmin mend the damage, and Si realises the site reflected the Endmin's own worries. Higher up, at a chess pavilion the Endmin once designed, a Yanese chess endgame has stumped two woodcutters for more than a thousand tries. Its pieces become living soldiers; the Endmin sacrifices the Chariot and a Pawn to win, then faces a final puzzle with no pieces left and steps onto the board as the last Pawn to deliver checkmate.

The strain makes the Endmin collapse, though the two repaired sites let Si pinpoint the injury. Si reveals that Ye Minghe is an Imperial Guard of Yan, recruited by Tianshi Tan of Hongshan. Near the peak she stalls, pretending her brush has run dry, because she fears the final treatment could kill the Endmin; the Endmin talks her into going on. Ye Minghe takes Si's place at the last and most dangerous site, which mirrors the Æther wound itself. In a deep recess of the Endmin's mind, shadows of Nefarith and Ardashir mock and warn that the Endmin will wither away saving others, a dying Endfield Operator affirms her faith in the Zeroth Directive, and at last the Endmin must face whether that Directive is just, and who the Endmin really is.

Afterwards Si and Ye Minghe confess that the whole climb was a trial the Endmin designed ten years ago as part of the Zeroth Directive. Si had painted the mountaintop Dijiang to store a portion of the Endmin's Originium authority, which could be reclaimed to suppress the Æther once the Endmin had reflected and re-synced with it. Back on the real Dijiang, Si duels the Endmin and then tells their story: over a century ago, just after the war, when the Civilization Band was taking shape, the Endmin coaxed the reclusive proxy out of her painting to help Hongshan. Ten years ago the Endmin headed north promising her a tour of Talos-II, then had an accident and slept a decade. Si's last task is to open a door to someone waiting.

Behind it is a portrait of the Endmin's past self, preserved by Si for this moment. The two talk like old friends about identity and the Directive, and conclude that the Endmin keeps rushing to the front line out of love for this world, from Endfield and Talos-II to Terra and even the Foundation. Relieved the answer has not changed, the past self hears the Endmin's journey since awakening and fades, passing on the spark. Si opens her painted world to Endfield on one condition: never forget her again. Ye Minghe reveals the Endmin saved him during the Polar Expedition ten years ago and vows to repay that debt. Only a few hours have passed on Dijiang, where Perlica relays M3's request: a formal visit to Rhodes Island, Endfield's predecessor.
lore: Si deepens the picture of the Feranmut Proxies. She has lived for more than a century, met the Endmin right after a war when the Civilization Band was forming, and her painting was a gift from one of her siblings. Her brush gives life to Ink Spirits, and objects near her grow minds of their own. In the original Arknights, the nation of Yan has the Sui, siblings descended from an ancient being, one of whom, Dusk, is a painter who lives inside the worlds she paints. Possibly Si is kin to them or modelled on that lineage, but the text itself names no such link. The process also ties HAS to Yan directly: the original Imperial Guards served only the True Lung of Yan and never reached Talos-II, so Tianshi Tan, cut off from Terra, founded a new unit, with Ye Minghe as its Captain of Pacified Skies.

The Endministrator's past grows stranger. The Endmin designed the Zeroth Directive, which binds the fates of many people, and is called a saviour by some and a tyrant, a traitor or even "Its Maker" by others, a title that echoes how Alleikhreos speaks of its own Maker. The past self says that by waking hours it is barely older than Perlica, which may suggest long stretches spent asleep. The Endmin's Originium authority can be stored outside the body and used against the Æther, showing Originium as the Endmin's main defence. Ten years ago the Polar Expedition in the north ended with the Endmin's accident and decade-long sleep. The fading past self names M3, Warfarin, Lesun and Zasso; Warfarin shares her name with a long-lived Sarkaz medic of Rhodes Island in the original game, so possibly she is that same figure.

The links to Terra are stated more openly than ever. The past self calls the Landbreakers loyalists of someone named Jakub and descendants of Siracusan families, Siracusa being a Terran nation of powerful Families in the original Arknights. It also remembers Zhuang Fangyi as Lin Yu's disciple, admits Ardashir was once close before he chose the Foundation, and hopes HAS may one day seal a planet-sized stellar rift. Perlica then explains that Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, the company at the heart of the original game, was Endfield's predecessor, led Originium technology on Talos-II, helped the first Terran explorers, faded from view after the Treaty of Confidence and was indispensable to creating Protocol-Originium. With the Exiles and the Foundation expected to return, the visit to Rhodes Island promises answers about where everything began.
